skills.name: stashui
skills.description: Builds web UI from the StashUI catalogue of ready-made, tested React components instead of writing components from scratch. Shows real images of the components so the choice is made by look, installs them and verifies the result, and can show an HTML mockup of the picks first when the user asks for one. Use for any request to build, design, redesign or polish a page, screen, section or component in a React and Tailwind project (landing page, dashboard, hero, pricing, navbar, form, modal), and whenever the user asks to find, pick or add a UI component.

skills.name: stashui-explore
skills.description: Explores several meaningfully different visual directions for a page using real StashUI components, and lets the user choose one before anything is built. Use when the user wants options, variants, concepts or a redesign direction, says "show me a few directions" or "what could this look like", or when a UI task starts with no decided look and no DESIGN.md. Not for a build whose direction is already chosen; use the stashui skill for that.

skills.name: stashui-review
skills.description: Reviews existing web UI with deterministic checks that return counts, then by looking at the rendered page, and fixes only what is provably wrong. Use for a UI audit, design QA, an accessibility or consistency check, "review this page", "why does this look off", or after building UI with the stashui skill. Not for building new UI; use the stashui skill for that.
